$MRNA just capped its best day ever, nearly tripling its value. 💰 

The stock surged on Wednesday after the company reported positive results from its late-stage trial of a melanoma vaccine developed with Merck.

Video

Bitcoin bounced back today. 🔥

It surged above $68,000 amid optimism over the Treasury increasing its buybacks of US debt.
The 30-year yield fell after the US Treasury Department said it would increase buybacks of long-dated government debt "by at least double."
The national debt just smashed through a new record high, clocking in at just north of $40 trillion. 🤯

China is getting a trade edge by avoiding the Strait of Hormuz and taking an alternative route through the Arctic that's being dubbed the "Ice Silk Road."

Read more: finance.yahoo.com/economy/po…

The Nasdaq wants to be the market that never sleeps. 💤

The Nasdaq says it will start trading stocks for 23 hours a day starting December 6.

The move is still subject to SEC approval and comes as the exchange ultimately wants to offer 24/7 trading.

Nasdaq president Tal Cohen says the expansion is a way to "broaden investor access and expand wealth-building opportunities" for everyone.

Rival NYSE has already won SEC approval for a 22-hour day running from 1:30 a.m. to 11:30 p.m.
